newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EKRANAS 5-MO NET DIPS, OPERATING PROFIT UP.
newsitem.headline: EKRANAS 5-MO NET DIPS, OPERATING PROFIT UP.

text.p: Lithuanian TV tubes maker Ekranas said on Friday that its net profit for the first five months of the year fell to six million litas from 8.3 million litas in the same period last year.
But it said that its operating profit rose to seven million litas in the first five months of 1997 from 6.2 million litas in the same period of last year.
"The net profit last year was higher since the government wrote off 2.1 million litas of overdue payments to the social insurance fund," spokeswoman Angelija Zokaitiene told Reuters.
The company earlier said its net profit for the first four months of the year was 5.5 million litas.
"The growth of operating profit despite a decline in sales shows the firm was operating more effectively," she added.
She said sales in the first five months fell to 116 million litas from 139 million litas in the same period last year.
"The German mark exchange rate is very unfavourable to the company and we were forced to slow our sales," Zokaitiene said.
The company hoped to boost sales after a free trade deal between Lithuania and Turkey was signed at the beginning of the month, as one of its main customers is Turkish Profilio-Telra.
The sales of the company were 331 million litas in 1996.
